description: Labelled cross-document contradiction set. Each item pairs a claim taken from a TA6 with a supporting document (title register / EPC / search / planning / correspondence). gold_label: contradict | consistent | neutral. Contradiction detection collapses {consistent, neutral} into 'not-contradict' for scoring. Hand-authored to reflect realistic conveyancing checks; extend before the final run.
